findings.name: trace_url resolves
findings.assertion: trace_url returned by /v2/chat/agent resolves via GET /v2/agent/runs/{run_id}/trace

findings.name: Trace event schema
findings.assertion: Each trace event has event_type and at least one content key (message/data/step_id/run_id/ts)

findings.name: Dashboard trace filters
findings.assertion: run_completed present; plan_created and tool_call_* are route-dependent and recorded
findings.note: Native brain_evidence route in this run did not emit plan_created; recorded as contract gap for LangGraph adapter design.

findings.name: Visual trace latest endpoint
findings.assertion: GET /brain/agent-trace/latest returns {success, events} and events is a list

findings.name: Visual trace stream route registration
findings.assertion: /brain/agent-trace/stream is registered in main app routes

findings.name: Trace run_root consistency
findings.assertion: Native trace resolves using current RUN_ROOT and event_count matches len(trace)

findings.name: Scope guard
findings.assertion: No source or frontend files modified
